document.shortDescription: South Shore Staten Island studio classes where kids learn sewing, fashion illustration, draping, and accessories design from age 6 up.
document.longDescription:
Staten Island Dance and Arts Center publishes a Fashion Design & Sewing program for children and teens at 26 Richmond Valley Road. The official fashion page lists Mini Fashion Design & Sewing for ages 6-8, a broader Fashion Design & Sewing class for ages 9+, and a Fashion Accessory Design track for ages 9+, each centered on sewing-machine skills, sketching, construction, and runway-show projects.

SIDAC's home page describes the studio as a community arts space offering classes across dance, art, musical theatre, cooking, and fashion, while the About page says the school was established in the town of Annadale. The public home and contact pages list the current studio phone 718-356-3760 and email ilovesidac@gmail.com. The home page also publishes office hours of Monday-Friday 4-7 PM and Saturday 10 AM-1 PM and points families to active 2025-2026 schedule graphics for current programming.

Because the public fashion page does not expose tuition or machine-readable class-time rows in the HTML captured here, this listing keeps pricing at 0 and limits schedule tags to source-backed weekday and weekend availability only. The listing image is an ImgBB re-host of SIDAC's own 2025-2026 schedule graphic.
